idea-plugin.name: C# Project Support
idea-plugin.description:
Basic support for C# / .NET projects in IntelliJ-based IDEs:
  • Rider-like Solution view: solutions (.sln, .slnx), solution folders, projects and their dependencies
  • C# syntax highlighting, commenting, brace matching
  • MSBuild project files (.csproj, .props, .targets) are treated as XML
